source: IPCC AR6 WG1 ch.5 (TCRE); Indicators of Global Climate Change 2025 (warming to date); Global Carbon Budget 2025 (emissions); Climate Action Tracker Nov 2025 (benchmark futures); UNEP/CCAC Global Methane Assessment 2021 (methane); IEA via Our World in Data (sector sizes)
note: All warming in C above 1850-1900. TCRE converted from 1.65C (1.0-2.3) per 1000 PgC to per 1000 GtCO2. Sector wedge sizes are current emissions: coal power ~10 GtCO2 (IEA), road transport ~6 (75% of 8 Gt transport, IEA 2018 via OWID), deforestation 4.1 (GCB 2025 land-use change), everything_else = 42.2 total - coal - road - deforestation - ~2 aviation+shipping. Methane: 40-45% cut by 2030 avoids ~0.3C by the 2040s (GMA 2021), modelled as a warming offset. Baseline shape (flat to 2050, then mild decline) is a modelling choice calibrated to land on CAT's current-policies 2.6C.
